item.title: Bulletin updated at 14:50 HKT 25/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The tropical cyclone now over the northern part of the South China Sea will move in the general direction of the vicinity of Leizhou Peninsula to the eastern part of Hainan Island today and tomorrow. There will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, the weather will remain unsettled over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. With the strengthening of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will improve and it will be very hot over southern China midweek next week.
